title: Vanguard's BND Offers Bigger Pay and Lower Fees Than Fidelity's FIGB
title_zh: Vanguard 的 BND 提供比 Fidelity 的 FigB 更高的薪酬和更低的费用
summary: These two bond ETFs offer broad exposure to the bond market, but one of the funds in particular may have a conisderable advantage.
summary_zh: 这两只债券 ETF 提供了广泛的债券市场敞口，但其中一只基金可能具有相当大的优势。

title: Vanguard BND Offers Broader Bond Mix Than BlackRock's IEI
title_zh: Vanguard BND 提供比贝莱德 IEI 更广泛的债券组合
summary: These two fixed-income ETFs hold much more safer bonds compared to other funds, but which one will be right for you?
summary_zh: 与其他基金相比，这两种固定收益 ETF 持有的债券更安全，但哪一种适合您呢？

title: Morning Movers: Tri Pointe surges after deal to be acquired
title_zh: Morning Movers：收购交易后 Tri Pointe 股价飙升
summary: Stock futures were trending lower, extending the pain from a sharp selloff in the previous session, but have improved following the January CPI release.
summary_zh: 股票期货呈走低趋势，延续前一交易日大幅抛售带来的痛苦，但在 1 月份 CPI 发布后有所改善。

title: Will the Stock Market Crash in Year 2 of Donald Trump's Second Term? Several Historically Correlated Events Offer a Clear Answer.
title_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普第二任期的第二年股市会崩盘吗？几个历史上相关的事件提供了明确的答案。
summary: When things seem too perfect on Wall Street, they often are.
summary_zh: 当华尔街的事情看起来过于完美时，事实往往确实如此。

title: Blackstone Repositions Portfolio With Urbaser Deal And Larger Anthropic Stake
title_zh: Blackstone 通过 Urbaser 交易和更大的 Anthropic 股份重新定位投资组合
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX), alongside EQT, has agreed to acquire Spain based waste management company Urbaser, expanding its exposure to infrastructure and environmental services.
summary_zh: Blackstone（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）与 EQT 已同意收购西班牙废物管理公司 Urbaser，扩大其在基础设施和环境服务领域的业务。
